title: Deformations of (2+1)-dimensional integrable systems and isotropic and anisotropic Harry Dym variants
summary: The deformation algorithm based on conservation laws can lift (1+1)-dimensional integrable systems to higher-dimensional counterparts while preserving Lax integrability, yet its generalization to (2+1)-dimensional models has remained an open problem. This paper establishes a unified deformation framework for two (2+1)-dimensional integrable equations: the anisotropic Kadomtsev-Petviashvili (KP) equation and the isotropic Nizhnik-Novikov-Veselov (NNV) equation.
